annotations.title: Will They Pay Me On Time?

description: A large customer's payment habits from the supplier's side, with what its lateness is worth on your invoice. From the company's statutory Payment Practices reports - typical days to pay against your terms, the share paid late and past 60 days, the trend over its last reports - and the statutory interest plus fixed compensation its typical lateness is worth on an invoice of your size. A company that doesn't report is said so.
name: will_they_pay
title: Will They Pay Me On Time?
